item.title: CPA workers' strike continues for 2nd day
item.description: CHATTOGRAM, Feb 8: The indefinite strike of the workers and the staff of the Chattogram Port Authority (CPA) has been continuing for the second day on Sunday in the second phase of their agitation after six days strike last week.The workers continuous strike crippled the operational activities of the country's principal sea port Chattogram. item.title: Japan PM Takaichi basks in historic election triumph

item.title: Real Madrid edge Valencia to stay on Barcelona's tail

item.title: Manna withdraws from Dhaka-18 election race
item.description: Nagorik Oikya Convener Mahmudur Rahman Manna has announced his withdrawal decision from the electoral race in the Dhaka-18 constituency, three days before the national election.He informed the matter in a post on his verified Facebook page around 12:30AM on Monday.Manna wrote, ''I am now in Bogura. Dhaka-18 is a very large constituency. The election there is so expensive. item.title: Tarique Rahman, Shafiqur Rahman to address nation this evening
item.description: Ahead of the 13th National Parliament Election and referendum, BNP Chairman Tarique Rahman and Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami Ameer Dr. Shafiqur Rahman will address the nation on Monday evening.State media Bangladesh Television (BTV) will broadcast the speeches of these two top leaders.According to BTV sources, Jamaat Ameer's speech will be broadcast in between 6 PM and 7 PM. Subsequently, BNP chief's address to the nation will be aired between 7 PM and 8 PM.

item.title: Dhaka Central University ordinance issued

item.title: Long-route buses will also ply on Feb 11: Owners association
item.description: The Bangladesh Bus-Truck Owners Association has said that long-route buses will operate across the country on February 11, one day before the national election.On Sunday (February 8), the association's president, Ramesh Chandra Ghosh, confirmed the matter to the media.Regarding bus operations on election day, the owners' association said that most long-distance bus services may remain temporarily suspended that day.
